name: savi-intake
description: Bring a legal matter to Savi Firm. Runs the firm's intake interview in your own Claude and sends it to the right attorney.

server_url.title: Savi Firm server address
server_url.description: The https address Savi Firm gave you, ending in /mcp. Without it the interview cannot be sent to the firm.

token.title: Savi Firm access token
token.description: The token Savi Firm gave you, if any. Leave blank if you were not given one.
